GLLOC.title: Locations
GLLOC.hint: Theatre-of-mind backdrop travel. Keep the party on one scene and change where they are by swapping the scene's background behind a cinematic transition, with a location name card on the reveal. Twenty-one transition styles, from a plain cut to an ink blot flooding the frame. Character art lit by Stage re-grades to the new backdrop automatically.
GLLOC.setting.pace.name: Transition pace
GLLOC.setting.pace.hint: Global speed multiplier for every transition. Below 1 is faster, above 1 is slower and more deliberate.
GLLOC.setting.settle.name: Hold before the reveal
GLLOC.setting.settle.hint: How long the transition waits after the new backdrop loads, in milliseconds. At 0 the reveal starts immediately and character art re-lights in the open as the new place appears. Higher values hide the relight, so the cast is already correct by the time you see it. 700 covers it fully.
GLLOC.setting.recenter.name: Fit the camera on arrival
GLLOC.setting.recenter.hint: Frame the whole scene under the curtain so the new backdrop is fully visible when the transition lifts. Turn this off if you position the camera yourself.
GLLOC.setting.motion.name: Transition motion
GLLOC.setting.motion.hint: How much movement transitions use on your screen. Affects only your client; the location name card always shows.
GLLOC.setting.motion.reduced: Reduced — gentler, and the disorienting styles become a fade
GLLOC.setting.motion.off: Off — every transition is an instant cut
